description: This script automates the installation process for the OpenClaw project. It ensures that certain prerequisites like git and Node.js are present, verifies their versions, downloads an installer script via curl, updates PATH, and verifies the CLI installation of OpenClaw. It handles version checks and conditional logic to manage the installation flow.

methods.name: verify_installed_cli
methods.description: Verifies that the specified CLI tool for OpenClaw is installed at the expected version.
